items.title: DIS Is Priced Like The Best Of Its Group. Is It?
items.summary: The market is charging a premium for Walt Disney stock, but its growth and profit metrics currently trail key rivals. Is this a bet on a magical future, or just a storybook valuation.

items.title: Maria Bartiromo Out at Fox News
items.summary: Fox News has parted ways with longtime anchor  Maria Bartiromo.  The journalist is no longer with Fox News Media, effective Thursday, the network said in a news release.  Bartiromo, 58, hadn’t been on Fox News or Fox Business for almost a month.

items.title: 3 S&P 500 Stocks That Fall Short
items.summary: The S&P 500 (^GSPC) is home to the biggest and most well-known companies in the market, making it a go-to index for investors seeking stability. But not all large-cap stocks are created equal - some are struggling with slowing growth, declining margins, or increased competition.

items.title: Rupert Murdoch Made A Simple Mistake When Constructing His Trust. It Cost Him $3.3 Billion to Fix. Here’s What Estate Planners Say You Should Do Instead.
items.summary: A single architectural flaw buried inside a 25-year-old family trust set off a legal battle that nearly tore the Murdoch empire apart, and the fix that finally ended it offers a cautionary lesson for anyone who thinks a signed trust document is the same as a finished plan.
